blocks.value: Many beginners think a ₹5,000 stock is bigger than a ₹500 stock. This is not true. To know how big a company really is, we use Market Capitalization.

Imagine This: Two apartment buildings have flats for sale. One has 20 luxury flats worth ₹1 crore each, while another has 500 flats worth ₹20 lakh each. Looking only at one flat's price doesn't tell you which building is larger.
Market Capitalization (Market Cap) is the total value of all a company's outstanding shares. It is calculated as Share Price × Total Number of Shares.
If a company has 10 crore shares and each share is worth ₹100, its Market Capitalization is ₹1,000 crore.
Never judge a company by its share price alone. Market Capitalization tells you its actual size.
